summary: Validated with validate --run <run> --submission update47.json returning valid=true. This updates the paused handoff in place rather than adding a new record, because its first listed execution still described the verification witness as needing at least two non-voters, which the arithmetic corrected last turn showed is not minimal. For three voters the quorum is two and the leader already counts itself, so one reachable non-voting member suffices; leaving the loose premise in the artifact a successor run reads first would risk constructing the wrong cluster and concluding the mechanism needs more support than it does. The corrected item now says to build the minimal case with a single non-voter and to vary the count upward to cover larger voter sets, and the discriminator and resume conditions carry the same instruction. Everything else in the handoff is unchanged: the other four items, their observations, the note that a run which cannot execute should leave the items rather than convert them into claims, the resume conditions including the purpose-built prefix needed for the snapshot-cycle item and the counterpart-version material needed for the pre-vote question, and the limitations stating that the record adds no source evidence, that ordering is by self-containment rather than severity, and that any item may be refuted by execution. No stop declaration is made, since budget expiry is a controller boundary.
